content: Xoossi Ba Asaas Gelida Caaqo Qaala Minththides
GODAY Muse, «Neni, Aarooney, Nadaabey, Abihuynne Isra7eeleppe laappun tammu dere halaqati GODAAKKO zuma bolla pude kezidi haahon eqqidi taas goynnite.
Gido attiin neni nerkka taakko shiiqa; harati ta mata shiiqopetto. Qasse asaykka nenara pude kezoppo» gides.
Musey yiidi GODAA qaalanne iza woga ubbaa asaas yootiin asay wuri issi qaalan, «GODAY yootidayssa ubbaa nuni ooththana» gides.

Musey GODAY yootidayssa ubbaa xaafides. Wonteththa gallas maalado wonttara dendidi zumaa garsan yarshizaso giigsidi Isra7eele asaa tammanne nam7u qommota sunththan tammanne nam7u shuch tuussa mala essides.
Izi Isra7eele asaappe naateththa attuma nayta kiittiin, istti biidi GODAAS mirgota xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarsho histti yarshida.
Musey suuththaafe baggaa ekkidi keretan qolides; attida suuththaa yarsho yarshiza sohozan cacafides.
Hessafe guye Caaqo Qaala Maxaafaa ekkidi asaas dhoqqu histtidi nababiin asay, «GODAY yootidayssa ubbaa nuni ooththananne azazettana» gides.
Museykka keretan attida suuththaa ekkidi asaa bolla wuxxidi asaa, «Be7ite, hayssi GODAY hayta qaalata inttes immishe inttenara woththida caaqo suuththa» gides.
Hessafe guye Musey, Aarooney, Nadaabey, Abihuynne Isra7eele halaqatappe laappun tammati pude kezidi,
Isra7eele Xoossaa be7ida; istti be7oyssika iza tohoppe garsara salo mala geeyi uttida simpere geetettiza shuchchafe oosettida miish misatiza wuyge dizayssako.
Gido attiin Xoossi Isra7eele asaa halaqata wodhibeenna; istti Xoossaa be7ida; iza sinththan midanne uyida.
Siina Zuma Bolla Muse Kes
GODAY Muses, «Neni taakko zumaa bolla pude haa ya; haa taakko kezada haan gam7a; histtiko neni wogaa tamaarsana mala tani wogaanne azazo iza bolla xaafida lochcha shuchchata nees immana» gides.
Hessafe guye Musey ba aylle Iyaasora baana keziin Musey pude Xoossa zumaa bolla kezides.
Isra7eele asaa halaqata izi, «Nuni intteko simmanaashe gakkanaas hayssan diishshite; Aarooneynne Huurey haan inttenara deettes; yo7oy diza asi oonikka isttako bo» gides.
Musey zumaa bolla pude keziin Xoossa shaaray zumaa kammides.
GODAA bonchchoyka Siina zumaa bolla wodhdhi gam7ides; usuppun gallas gakkanaas shaarazi zumaa goozi oykkides; laappunththa gallassan shaaraa giddora GODAY Muse xeygides.
Isra7eele naytas GODAA bonchchoy zumaa xeeran eexxiza tama misatidi beettides.
Hessafe guye Musey he shaaraa giddo gelidi pude zumaa bolla kezidi heen oyddu tammu gallassinne oyddu tammu qamma gam7ides.
